program.address_context: Original unrelocated file-backed EE PT_LOAD; M18 synthesized rows.

provenance.source: Authenticated Japanese ELF; rows decoded by the private M15 R5900 decoder.
limitations: Original-instruction versus C equivalence is a separate differential (tools/verify_front_end_differential.py) and native lifecycle run (tools/run_front_end_native.py).
The text column is an analysis aid; bytes are authoritative.

functions.name: fade_reset_00138fa0
functions.interpretation: hg_fade_reset: clears the fade block gp+2f40.

functions.name: fade_clear_00138fd0
functions.interpretation: hg_fade_clear(blend, guard): phase 0, level 0 unless the 00a6bf95 guard is set.

functions.name: fade_out_00139040
functions.interpretation: hg_fade_out(step, blend, mode, layer): phase 3, kind 4/5/7 for mode 1/2/3 else 3; mode 1 also sets the pause-capture flag 700000d4 = 1.

functions.name: fade_in_001390b0
functions.interpretation: hg_fade_in(step, blend, layer, guard): phase 1, kind 2.

functions.name: fade_service_00139240
functions.interpretation: hg_fade_service: per-frame fade step by kind (table 003db1f0) and the fade quad draws 0014a0a0/0014f370 (bus calls).

functions.name: pad_service_0013d970
functions.interpretation: hg_pad_service: port state machine, read and the game copies gp+2f90..2fc8.

functions.name: pad_port_0013dc30
functions.interpretation: hg_pad_port: libpad port state machine (11 states, table 003db210); libpad entries are bus calls (IOP boundary).

functions.name: pad_read_0013e090
functions.interpretation: hg_pad_read: scePadRead buffer to held/edge/repeat words, pressure and analog conversion (0013e5b0 is a bus call).

functions.name: new_game_state_00141980
functions.interpretation: hg_new_game_state: area triple (1,0,0), empty name (0011af00, format 003db280), default options and controls.

functions.name: pause_menu_00162750
functions.interpretation: hg_pause_menu, state = mode +c (table 003db630): states 0, 1, 2, 4, 6, 7 and 0x11 reconstructed (resume, title, teardown/quit and the confirmation); the other states fail closed with a domain fault.

functions.name: title_card_scan_002cf020
functions.interpretation: hg_title_card_scan: memory-card presence scan (00966500..0096651c), 1 save present, 2 no card/save; sceMc entries are bus calls.
